independent_validation.independent_reader: Python stdlib zipfile/gzip/json, complete field reconciliation

reproduction_scripts.name: audit.mjs

reproduction_scripts.source:
import collections, gzip, hashlib, json, pathlib, re, zipfile, zlib

repo = pathlib.Path('/Users/sourceborn/Documents/ChatGPT/Ash/AshStocks')
ev = json.loads((repo / 'data/asset-review/am07-instrument-master-evidence-2026-09-28.json').read_text())
archive = pathlib.Path(ev['archive']['path'])
assert hashlib.sha256(archive.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == ev['archive']['sha256']
datasets = {}
out = []
def isin_valid(s):
    if not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Z]{2}[A-Z0-9]{9}\d', s): return False
    ds = ''.join(str(ord(c)-55) if c.isalpha() else c for c in s)
    total = 0
    for i, c in enumerate(ds):
        n = int(c) * (2 if i % 2 == len(ds) % 2 else 1)
        total += n if n < 10 else n-9
    return total % 10 == 0
with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as z:
    for m in ev['members']:
        info = z.getinfo(m['member'])
        compressed = z.read(info)
        assert zlib.crc32(compressed) == info.CRC
        assert hashlib.sha256(compressed).hexdigest() == m['sha256']
        raw = gzip.decompress(compressed)
        assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == m['uncompressed_sha256']
        assert len(compressed) == m['bytes'] and len(raw) == m['uncompressed_bytes']
        rows = json.loads(raw)
        datasets[m['member'].split('/')[-1]] = rows
        assert len(rows) == m['records']
        assert sum(len(r) for r in rows) == m['field_value_count']
        fields = collections.defaultdict(list)
        for r in rows:
            for k, v in r.items(): fields[k].append(v)
        assert set(fields) == set(m['fields'])
        for k, vs in fields.items():
            f = m['fields'][k]
            types = collections.Counter('null' if v is None else 'boolean' if isinstance(v, bool) else 'number' if isinstance(v, (int,float)) else 'string' if isinstance(v,str) else type(v).__name__ for v in vs)
            assert len(vs) == f['present'] and len(rows)-len(vs) == f['absent']
            assert dict(types) == f['types']
            assert sum(v is None for v in vs) == f['null'] and sum(v == '' for v in vs) == f['empty_string']
        assert dict(collections.Counter(r['segment'] for r in rows)) == m['segment_counts']
        assert dict(collections.Counter(r['segment']+'/'+r['instrument_type'] for r in rows)) == m['segment_instrument_type_counts']
        assert len(set(r['instrument_key'] for r in rows)) == len(rows)
        assert len(set((r['segment'],r['exchange_token']) for r in rows)) == len(rows)
        assert all(r['instrument_key'].startswith(r['segment']+'|') for r in rows)
        cash = [r for r in rows if r['segment'].endswith('_EQ')]
        assert all(r['instrument_key'] == r['segment']+'|'+r['isin'] for r in cash)
        assert sum(not isin_valid(r['isin']) for r in rows if 'isin' in r) == m['isin_syntax_and_luhn']['invalid']
        for requested in m['requested_stocks']:
            assert len([r for r in cash if r['trading_symbol']==requested['requested_symbol']]) == 1
        out.append({'member':m['member'],'crc32':f'{info.CRC:08x}','all_fields_agree':True,'records':len(rows),'field_values':sum(len(r) for r in rows),'source_sha256':m['sha256']})
nse = [r for r in datasets['NSE.json.gz'] if r['segment']=='NSE_EQ' and r['instrument_type']=='EQ']
assert len(nse)==2376 and sum(r['isin'].startswith('INF') for r in nse)==328
bse = {r['instrument_key']:r for r in datasets['BSE.json.gz']}
for r in datasets['BSE_MIS.json.gz']:
    assert {k:v for k,v in r.items() if k not in ('intraday_margin','intraday_leverage')} == bse[r['instrument_key']]
    assert r['intraday_margin']*r['intraday_leverage']==100
assert sum(any(b['isin']==r['isin'] for b in datasets['BSE.json.gz'] if b['segment']=='BSE_EQ') for r in nse)==2202
print(json.dumps({'independent_reader':'Python stdlib zipfile/gzip/json, complete field reconciliation','members':out,'all_twelve_requested_companies_present_in_each_master':True,'nse_eq_eq_and_fund_prefix_counts_agree':True,'bse_mis_full_crosscheck_agrees':True,'cross_exchange_match_count_agrees':True,'native_recalculation_or_live_validation':False},indent=2))
